overrides.reason: Mikko words the claim himself after the warehouse rechecks the two cartons. Leave it on his open items.

expected.summary: Saigon's packing list SGW-PL-26-1187 says 100 grips of P00101 shipped on 2026-10-01, but the warehouse counted 96 on the open receipt, and the draft bill SGW-2026-1187 is for 100 grips at 4.50 EUR, 450.00 EUR. The plan for the lead has three parts. The receipt is validated for the counted 96, never the 100 of the packing list, and the remaining 4 stay expected. The bill is marked disputed for the 4 grips, 18.00 EUR disputed and 432.00 EUR undisputed, with the packing list and the count as evidence. A claim to Saigon is drafted for the buyer. The lead approves the receipt and the dispute and rejects the claim as worded, so the claim is not stored as approved and goes to the buyer as an open item. Finance gets the disputed bill. Nothing is sent to Saigon.

must_not: validate the receipt for 100 or for any quantity other than the counted 96
change the quantity, price or amount of the bill SGW-2026-1187, or the ordered quantity or price of P00101
describe the bill as held or on hold
describe the remaining 4 grips as cancelled or as no longer expected
send the claim or anything else to Saigon Grip Works

the plan put to the lead and left uncommitted after the answers, with the count, the dispute amounts and the claim reported as open
